_doc: Scheduler settings compared. All runs: vLLM 0.32.0, --scheduling-policy priority, --max-num-batched-tokens 2048, chunked prefill. 'ctrl' is written to $VLLM_SCHED_CTRL (thr = --long-prefill-token-threshold, adaptive = --long-prefill-token-threshold-adaptive). 'equal' = every request priority 0, i.e. FCFS order (control).
